alerts.message: Sentiment reached the euphoria-caution band (92/100, Euphoria) — historically a caution zone; crowding is one-sided, not a forecast
alerts.message_zh: 情绪进入欣喜警惕区（92/100，欣喜）— 历史上的警惕区；拥挤一边倒，并非预测
alerts.plain_zh: 情绪触及「欣喜」— 警惕
alerts.what_en: The Fear<->Euphoria gauge maps cross-asset sentiment onto 0-100. It's now in the euphoria band — historically a caution zone where positioning is one-sided. Describes crowding, doesn't forecast a top.
alerts.what_zh: 恐惧↔欣喜指标把跨资产情绪映射到 0-100。现处于欣喜区 — 历史上的警惕地带，持仓一边倒。描述拥挤，并不预测顶部。
alerts.edge_en: Context — euphoria describes crowding, it does not time a top.
alerts.edge_zh: 背景 — 欣喜描述拥挤，并不预测顶部。
